communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: OpenAI / Stargate federal financing, tax-support & energy records (2024–present) (United States Dept of Commerce)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request existing agency records dated January 1, 2024, through the date the search is conducted.

Please search for the following existing record types that contain at least one Entity below AND at least one Search Term below:

RECORD TYPES
emails (including attachments); calendars; briefing memoranda; decision memoranda; options papers; talking points; slide decks; meeting notes and readouts; applications; funding opportunity announcements / NOFOs / solicitations; term sheets; letters of intent; MOUs; NDAs; commitment letters; agreements; approvals; credit or risk assessments; scorekeeping memoranda; guidance, FAQs, and technical advice; NEPA, permitting, and environmental review records; congressional correspondence; and inspector general audit or evaluation records.

ENTITIES
OpenAI
@openai.com
"Sam Altman"
Stargate

SEARCH TERMS
"data center"
hyperscale
"AI infrastructure"
"artificial intelligence"
"AI Action Plan"
"America's AI Action Plan"
"EO 14179"
"Executive Order 14179"
superintelligence
"super intelligence"
ASI
"loan guarantee"
LPO
"Title 17"
"Loan Programs Office"
"credit support"
"credit subsidy"
indemnification
"loss sharing"
backstop
"contingent liability"
"private credit"
"tax credit"
"tax expenditure"
"accelerated depreciation"
"bonus depreciation"
"investment tax credit"
ITC
"Section 48"
"Section 45"
"Section 174"
grant
subsidy
"financial assistance"
interconnection
"power purchase"
PPA
grid
"federal land"
permitting
FAST-41
NEPA

This request seeks existing records locatable by ordinary electronic search. It does not ask the agency to investigate, analyze, answer questions, identify unknown parties, decide whether any record "benefits" a company, or create new records. I do not seek third-party tax return information under 26 U.S.C. § 6103. Please provide records electronically.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Zachary

communications.subject: General Services Administration FOIA Request Acknowledgement
communications.communication:
Dear ZacharyZachary, 
The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) has received your FOIA request and assigned request number 2027-FOI-00203 . You will receive a more detailed acknowledgment letter from GSA. Please use this number in all future correspondence regarding this request. 
If you have not done so already, please egister with GSA’s Public Access Link (PAL) to create an online profile with the email address used to submit this request. This will allow you to receive correspondence, view documents, check the status of your request, and make payments . Helpful instructions on how to register using Login.gov can be found here . 
If you have any additional questions concerning GSA FOIA requests, please email GSA.FOIA@gsa.gov
Regards, 
FOIA Requester Service Center 
U.S. General Services Administration
